blocks.text: Precision aur accuracy ki istilahein physics ki paimaishon mein aksar istemal hoti hain aur inhen saaf alag karna chahiye. Paimaish ki precision istemal hone wale instrument ya device se tay hoti hai: least count jitna chhota, paimaish utni precise. Accuracy kisi physical quantity ki paimaish ka us ki theek ya tasleem shuda qeemat se qareeb hona hai; yeh fractional ya percentage uncertainty se bayan hoti hai, aur fractional ya percentage uncertainty jitni chhoti, paimaish utni accurate.

Maslan, kisi cheez ki lambai 25.5 cm record hoti hai aise metre rule se jis ka sab se chhota division millimetre hai. Us ki precision ya absolute uncertainty (least count) +/-0.1 cm hai, to fractional uncertainty 0.1 cm / 25.5 cm = 0.004 aur percentage uncertainty (0.1 cm / 25.5 cm) x 100 = 0.4% hai. Ek aur paimaish, 0.01 cm least count wale Vernier callipers se, 0.45 cm record hoti hai; us ki precision ya absolute uncertainty +/-0.01 cm hai, to fractional uncertainty 0.01 cm / 0.45 cm = 0.02 aur percentage uncertainty (0.01 cm / 0.45 cm) x 100 = 2% hai.

Yun metre rule se li gayi reading 25.5 cm kam precise magar zyada accurate hai, kyunke us ki percentage uncertainty ya error chhoti hai, jabke Vernier callipers se li gayi reading 0.45 cm zyada precise magar kam accurate hai. Dar asal nisbati paimaish hi aham hai: physical quantity jitni chhoti, utna zyada precise instrument istemal hona chahiye. Yahan 0.45 cm ki paimaish zyada precise instrument maangti hai, jaise 0.001 cm least count wala micrometer screw gauge.

blocks.title: Precise aur accurate paimaishein
blocks.text: Precise paimaish woh hai jis ki precision ya absolute uncertainty kam ho, aur accurate paimaish woh jis ki fractional ya percentage uncertainty kam ho. Hum kabhi bilkul theek (exact) paimaish nahi kar sakte; behtareen yeh hai ke napne wale instrument ki had ke andar jitna mumkin ho qareeb aayein.

blocks.prompt: Ek talib-e-ilm taar ka diameter metre rule se 0.3 mm aur mez ki lambai 1 mm wale tape se 1.253 m napta hai. Kaun si paimaish zyada precise aur kaun si zyada accurate hai, aur talib-e-ilm ko kya badalna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Dono instruments ka least count 1 mm hai, to dono readings barabar precise hain. Taar ki reading ki percentage uncertainty (1/3) x 100, taqreeban 33% hai, jabke mez ki (1/1253) x 100, taqreeban 0.08%, to mez ki lambai kahin zyada accurate hai. Chhota diameter zyada precise instrument se napna chahiye, 0.01 mm ya behtar least count wale micrometer screw gauge se.

items: Precision: least count (absolute uncertainty) se tay; accuracy: asal qeemat se qareebi, fractional ya percentage uncertainty se zahir.

Metre rule se 25.5 cm: 0.4%, kam precise magar zyada accurate; Vernier callipers se 0.45 cm: 2%, zyada precise magar kam accurate; chhoti quantities ko zyada precise instruments chahiye (screw gauge, 0.001 cm). Koi paimaish exact nahi.
